description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of response types across two conditions — labeled “Standard” and an unlabeled top condition — as part of an evaluation in the paper “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision.” Each horizontal bar is segmented into three colored components representing “Context” (blue), “Generated Response” (orange), and “Other” (green), with percentage values shown within each segment. In the top, unlabeled condition, the distribution is 60.6% Context, 31.7% Generated Response, and 7.7% Other. In the “Standard” condition below, the distribution shifts to 23.6% Context, 51.1% Generated Response, and 25.3% Other. The chart uses a horizontal stacked bar format, with categories listed on the y-axis and percentage values along the x-axis (implied, unlabeled). The legend at the bottom clarifies the color coding for each response type. The visual contrast highlights a substantial increase in “Generated Response” and “Other” categories under the “Standard” condition, while “Context” decreases significantly compared to the top condition.
